profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Interested in areas including data analytics, software development, consulting, and research.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- Redesigned solver for infinite-stream constraint satisfaction problems using C++ coroutines and inheritance
- Priortized for efficiency, clear code organization, and extensibility for various constraint types/consistency algorithms

positions.title: Head TA / TA
positions.description:
- Head TA for Prescriptive Analytics; topics included routing/scheduling/satisfiability problems, linear/integer/constraint programming, designing heuristics/optimizations/search meta-heuristics, and evaluating the quality of our solutions
- TA for Machine Learning
- TA for CS: An Integrated Introduction

positions.title: Quantitative Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed CNNs to take an image of a figure, infer skeleton positioning, and orient a 3D model to match the image
- Parallelized pipelines to efficiently render terabytes (tens of millions) of images of 3D models in Blender and Maya 
- Designed efficient processes for image-segmentation and other image transformations to rapidly produce large datasets
- Created various network architectures using TensorFlow and interfaced them with Blender
- Created an application to allow researchers to annotate images of the same scene from different views while ensuring the annotations are consistent in 3D

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern, Alexa ML Data Platform
positions.description:
- Created Java service to monitor schema and usage of data collected by Alexa devices, allowing data-providing and data-consuming engineering teams to communicate/develop more efficiently
- Interfaced with various cloud services, tested with Mockito

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed C++ application to make hundreds of simultaneous video calls within a single process, allowing engineers to more effectively load test company servers
- Focused on multithreading to conserve system resources and establishing media streams via PJSIP libraries

positions.title: Genetics Research Intern
positions.description:
- Developed process for RNA sequencing on microfluidic chip through the Broad Summer Scholars Program 
- Presented results to MIT and Harvard researchers at poster session

company.name: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

honors.title: Denis Cleary Moot Court Competition Winning Team
honors.description: Worked with a teammate to argue past and present Supreme Court cases as an attorney
